Question: Matrix Chain Multiplication (MCM)

You are given a sequence of matrices.

If there are N matrices, you are given an array arr[] of size N+1 where:

Matrix 1 has dimension arr[0] × arr[1]

Matrix 2 has dimension arr[1] × arr[2]

...

Matrix N has dimension arr[N-1] × arr[N]

Your task is to determine the minimum number of scalar multiplications needed to multiply the entire chain.

You can change the parenthesization order, but the matrix order must remain the same.

Input Format
N
arr0 arr1 arr2 ... arrN

Where:

N = number of matrices

arr size = N + 1

Output Format

Print a single integer —
minimum multiplication cost.
